name: Impromptu by Paul Lee
address: B1, Regent Hotel, 3, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei
addressZh: 中山區中山北路二段39巷3號B1 (晶華酒店)

menus.name: chef's tasting menu
menus.note: Dinner only; wine pairing NT$3,680 (7 glasses), or sake NT$2,580, cocktail NT$1,980 or alcohol-free NT$1,280 pairings. Dishes changed only for allergies or religious diets

bookingOpens: Online on inline, up to 30 days ahead; for later dates or special requests, call or email info@impromptu.com.tw. Phone bookings 2pm to 5pm on opening days. A card must be linked within three days of booking to guarantee the table.
cancellation: Cancel or change at least eight days ahead. Within seven days, the restaurant charges the tasting menu price (before service) for each guest booked; the same applies to no-shows.
groups: Parties of six or more and the private room are booked by phone or email.
dressCode: No flip-flops; men are asked not to wear slippers or open-toed sandals.
duration: Two and a half to three hours.
byob: Corkage NT$1,000 a bottle of wine and NT$1,500 a bottle of spirits (more for bottles over 750ml).
